MARKE.|131 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>the Prophet saying, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ezech. 7, 26.''}}''The Law shal perish from the Priest and counsel from the Ancients''. {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Priesthod of the new Testament.}}But the Priesthod of the new Testament is to continew vnto the end of the world, and hath (as being the principal part of the Church) the assistāce of the Holy Ghost for euer promised, to teach it al truth: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 16, 13. Luc. 22 and 10''.}}and for Peter the cheefe Priest thereof vnder Christ, our Sauiour praied, That his faith should not faile: and to the rest he said, ''He that heareth you, heareth me''.

''15. To satisfie the people.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Executīg lawes against innocents.}}Pilate should haue suffered death, rather then by other mens prouocation or commaundement haue executed an innocent: as a Christian iudge should rather suffer al extremitie, then giue sentence of death against a Catholike man for his faith.

''46. Bying sindon.''] {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Religious duty toward the bodies of Christ and his Saincts.}}This dutie done to Christes body after his departure, was exceding meritorious, and is therfore by holy write so often commended for an example to faithful men, to vse al honour and deuotion towards the bodies of Saincts and holy persons.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. XVI.}}}}}}

{{c|''The third day, to three vvomen at his Sepulcher, an Angel telleth that he is risen, and vvil (as he promised Mar. 14, 28.) shevv him self in Galilee. 9 The same day he appeareth to Marie Magdalene, aftervvard to tvvo Disciples: yet the Eleuen vvil not beleeue it, vntil to them also he appeareth. 15 To vvhom hauing giuen commission into al nations, vvith povver also of Miracles, he ascendeth, and they plant his Church euery vvhere.''}} {{dropinitial|A|fl={{verse|chapter=16|verse=1}}}}{{sc|Nd}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Easter day.}}vvhen the Sabboth vvas past, Marie Magdalene and Marie of Iames, and Salôme {{sup|‖}} bought spices, that comming they might anoint {{sc|Iesvs}}.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 28, 1. Luc. 24, 1. Io. 20, 1.''}} {{verse|chapter=16|verse=2}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text={{sc|Easter Day}}.}}And very early the first of the Sabboths, they come to the monument: the sunne being novv risen. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=3}}† And they said one to an other, VVho shal roll vs backe the stone from the doore of the monument? {{verse|chapter=16|verse=4}}† And looking, they savv the stone rolled backe. for it vvas very great. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=5}}† And entring into the monument, they savv a yong man sitting on the right hand, couered vvith a vvhite robe: and they vvere astonied. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=6}}† VVho saith to them, Be not dismaied: you seeke {{sc|Iesvs}} of Nazareth, that vvas crucified: he is risen, he is not here, behold the place vvhere they laid him. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=7}}† But goe, tel his Disciples and {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Peter is named in special (as often els where) for prerogatiue.}}∷ Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there you shal see him, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 28.''}}* as he told you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=16|verse=8}}† But they going forth, fled from the monument. for trembling and feare had inuaded them: and they said nothing to any body. for they vvere afraid.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=9}}† And he rising early the first of the Sabboth, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 20, 16.''}}* appeared first to Marie Magdalene, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 8, 2.''}}* out of vvhom he had cast seuen deuils. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=10}}† She vvent and told them that had been vvith him, that vvere mourning and vveeping. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=11}}† And they hearing that he vvas aliue and had been seen of her, did not beleeue.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=12}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lu. 24, 13.''}}* after this he appeared {{sup|‖}} in an other shape to tvvo<noinclude>{{rh||R ij|of}}</noinclude>
